ai_show_review.summary: Fiery MIT set with scorching Dancin' In The Street and tight China>Rider
ai_show_review.blurb: The show delivers an incendiary Dancin' In The Street and soaring Morning Dew, backed by a flawless China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider segue. Jerry’s guitar is in the zone throughout, while the rhythm section drives the set with relentless energy.
ai_show_review.review: On May 6 1970 at Kresge Plaza, MIT, the Dead turned the cold‑weather tension of the era into a high‑octane performance that still feels urgent today. Opening with a blistering Dancin' In The Street, Jerry Garcia’s SG thrashes with perfect tone, setting a charged mood that carries through an immaculate China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider transition and a soaring Morning Dew. Phil Lesh anchors the jams with a devastating bass run that shines especially on Dew, while Bob Weir adds steady rhythm guitar and even steps up for a spoken announcement after Not Fade Away. The second half builds to a powerful Saint Stephen into Not Fade Away climax, punctuated by the band’s signature drive on Good Lovin' and a rousing Casey Jones. Across all available soundboard recordings the playing is consistently praised as “locked‑in” and “self‑generating electricity,” making this a must‑listen snapshot of the early ’70 Dead in top form.

best_recording.reason: Sharp mono soundboard capture with clear instrument separation; despite occasional dropouts it preserves the band's dynamics and intensity better than other sources.

key_highlights: Incendiary Dancin' In The Street jam
Seamless China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider segue
Soaring Morning Dew with standout bass work
Powerful Saint Stephen into Not Fade Away momentum

band_performance.Jerry: Thrashing SG, perfect tone and 'in the zone' throughout; described as a self‑generating source of electricity and thunderous yet nuanced.
band_performance.Phil: Devastating bass run that anchors intense jams; big presence on Morning Dew and solid foundation for the set.
band_performance.Bob: Provides spoken announcement after Not Fade Away, shares vocal duties with Pigpen, and offers steady rhythm guitar support.
band_performance.Mickey: Delivers a strong, consistent rhythmic drive that underpins the set’s momentum.
band_performance.Billy: Matches Mickey in delivering tight, energetic drumming; key to the powerful Good Lovin' intro and overall drive.
